description: Veterinarian-founded pet wellness brand making science-backed supplements for dogs and cats (founded 2017 by veterinarian Dr. Michelle Dulake). It recruits creators through three live routes at once: a GRIN creator program paying 20% per sale with free product, an Awin affiliate program that expressly targets pet influencers and creators, and its own Ambassador Program paying cash commissions from $10 per order.

evidence.summary: Fera Pets' official Awin merchant profile fetched in full: the brand is 'actively looking to partner with' pet influencers and creators, veterinarians and vet tech creators, pet wellness publishers and TikTok/Instagram/YouTube/blog creators, with 'dedicated affiliate support' and seasonal campaign opportunities. The Awin profile publishes no commission rate, cap statement or creator count.

Fera Pets' GRIN Marketplace profile lists one active partner program: '20% per sale — earn commission on every sale you drive', free product (Longevity Soft Chews for Dogs), and one deliverable (1 Instagram Reel within 30 days of receiving the gift), with a creative brief on application. The same profile lists the brand's external Ambassador Program: 'Earn cash commissions starting at $10 per order, receive a custom promo code... 7-day cookie period.' The recorded route is the GRIN creator program at 20%; the ambassador floor and the Awin route are documented here. Creator pitches are taken at ambassadors@ferapets.com per the brand's creator-program listings. No earnings-cap statement and no creator count are published on any fetched page, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

reasons.opportunity_availability: The GRIN program is listed active now and the Awin profile says the brand is actively recruiting; the GRIN route requires one Reel deliverable per gift.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Three simultaneous creator routes (GRIN program with a written creative brief, an Awin profile naming influencers and UGC channels, and an ambassador scheme) — the strongest creator evidence in this group.
